function.name: get_ai_alternatives
function.description:
Used to search alternatives for the most recent product the client interacted with.
Returns alternative products along with a short explanation that describes why they were chosen, or simply states that no suitable alternatives were found.

barcode.description: The ID of the most recent product the client interacted with.

allergies.description: All client allergies. if no allergies, should be empty array.

requirement.description: A short text describing exactly what the client wants from the alternative products.

dietary_needs.description: A list of the client's dietary needs. should be empty if none.
